claims.sourceText: Câmara dos Deputados, RIC 679/2011, item 1.3 and justificação, 22 June 2011 (https://www.camara.leg.br/proposicoesWeb/prop_mostrarintegra?codteor=891762&filename=RIC+679%2F2011)
claims.text: DOU RECORD FOUND (by citation, not by page image). A Chamber of Deputies information requirement cites the underlying process 'citado no Diário Oficial da União de 10 de agosto de 2010, Seção I - página 101', and states that 'no dia 10 de agosto do ano passado a Força Aérea admitira e abrira oficialmente parte do seu esquema de procedimentos quanto ao assunto dos OVNIs, por meio da publicação no DOU da Portaria 551/GC3'. Publication is therefore attested by a primary parliamentary document independent of the FAB's own note: DOU of 10 August 2010, Seção 1, p. 101. The in.gov.br page image itself could not be retrieved.

claims.sourceText: Câmara dos Deputados, Requerimento de Informações (RIC) 679/2011, Dep. Chico Alencar (PSOL/RJ), 22 June 2011, item 1.2 (https://www.camara.leg.br/proposicoesWeb/prop_mostrarintegra?codteor=891762&filename=RIC+679%2F2011)
claims.text: The operation's commander is named in a Chamber of Deputies information requirement as 'coronel Uyrangê Bolivar Soares Nogueira de Hollanda Lima', described as having narrated the missing film and photographic material to ufologists 'antes de sua morte em 1997'. This fixes both the full name and the 1997 death in a primary parliamentary document.

edges.label: Portaria 551/GC3 (9 Aug 2010): COMDABRA/COMAE catalogues, CENDOC forwards originals periodically
edges.note: Art. 3 mandates periodic transfer of originals, which is why the fund has no terminal year. Published DOU 10 Aug 2010, Seção 1, p. 101. Revoked Nota C-002/MIN/ADM (13 Apr 1978) and Aviso S-001/MIN (28 Feb 1989). Successive accessions are documented at least to a 'terceiro recolhimento' covering 1981, with CENDOC's bulk remittance to COREG scheduled to close 31 Aug 2010; FAB states coverage now runs 1952-2025.

edges.label: SIAN search 'operação prato' returns 6 documents, none audiovisual
edges.note: Arquivo Nacional's own answer to a litigant, quoted in the 2023 federal judgment. Contrasts with the 2011 parliamentary finding that hundreds of photographs (of 500+) and hours of super 8 / super 16mm film were never transferred from I COMAR. The court found insufficient evidence that the audiovisual files exist; the parliamentary record asserts they did. Both positions are on the record and are not reconciled.
